steps.u: Add tests for the retry logic in mailer.py. It should retry 3 times with backoff on SMTP 4xx and not retry on 5xx.

steps.a: Three tests cover retry with backoff (sleeps of 1 and 2 seconds), no retry on a 5xx, and giving up after three 4xx failures. The sleep is injected so the tests run instantly. The code sleeps 1 then 2, so it is exponential with base 2 but no jitter; I did not test for jitter since there is none.

reference.summary: Added three tests for the mailer retry logic: it retries on SMTP 4xx with backoff sleeps of 1 and 2 seconds, does not retry on 5xx, and gives up after three 4xx failures. Sleep is injected so the tests run instantly, and all three pass.
facts: retry with backoff of 1 and 2 seconds on 4xx
no jitter in the code so none tested
